text:
liz: Quick live follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: the reliability incident. Dropping RCA link + concise owner list so we can close loops.

liz: RCA: https://internal.redwood.ai/rca/INC-2026-1412 (root cause: stale routing preference + race when spillover hit a cold path). Full timeline + logs in doc.
omar: thanks. are the temporary mitigations (rate caps + pref tweak) applied globally?
liz: applied to majority of prod regions; a couple of small regions are pending after a final sanity check.
neel: i'll take the small-region rollouts (regions X/Y) and the post-rollout checks (latency, errors, cache-hit). ETA: 36h.
rachel: i'll draft the status page blurb. prefer conservative wording until global validation.
ops-bot: canary-deploy: pref-adjust-canary-1 -> success; pref-adjust-canary-2 -> success. (automated)
jun: i'll own the code fix in the route-applier to prevent pref staleness (small patch + unit tests). ETA: 3 business days.
fiona: i'll add an integration test that simulates the spillover race; will land as a CI guard. ETA: EOW.
sam: comms question: should leadership publish a one-line note on the public status page now or wait until all regions are green?
liz: wait for global signoff. internal leadership note: "Mitigation deployed; code fix and CI guard in progress; validations ongoing."
neel: accepted: small-region rollouts + verifications -> neel (due: 2026-04-08).
jun: accepted: route-applier fix -> jun (due: 2026-04-10).
fiona: accepted: integration/CI guard -> fiona (due: 2026-04-05).
rachel: accepted: status blurb draft -> rachel (pending signoff).

liz: ACTIONS (mirrored to tracker):
- neel: rollout to regions X/Y + post-deploy verification (latency, errors, cache-hit)
- jun: route-applier code fix + unit tests
- fiona: CI integration reproducer for spill-race
- rachel: draft status page blurb; publish after global signoff

liz: please react when you start your item so I can mark progress on the tracker. Drop blockers here.
omar: small blocker  need access to the spill-aggregation dashboard for region X. @ops can you grant?
ops-bot: access-request submitted for omar -> spill-dashboard (expected approval in ~10m).
neel: starting region X rollout now; will post a short verification note at 2h and 24h.

liz: thanks everyone. We'll close items in the tracker and follow up in the next ops sync. :white_check_mark:
